text:
tay: quick note: found deterministic token drift when loading our roundtripped int4 artifacts with very long prefixes (~70k). Shorter prefixes OK. Repro below.

sam: paste command + minimal logs?

tay: repro:```bash
python -m tests.long_run --model artifacts/llamaX-rt-int4 --baseline artifacts/llamaX-fp16 --prefix tests/prefixes/70k_chain.txt --seed 99
```
logs:```
[2026-03-20T05:02:10Z] INFO kv: applying_prefill count=32768 shard=1
[2026-03-20T05:02:10Z] WARN rope: phase_wrap candidate=32768 period=40960
[2026-03-20T05:02:11Z] ERROR kv_verify: expected_idx=32768 got_idx=65504 layer=12
```

ravi: that expected vs got looks like nibble misalignment. Any diffs in serialized offsets/headers?

tay: yes, serializer metadata shows pack_alignment toggled from 0 -> 8 for a subset of layers. Payload offsets shifted by +8 for some shards.

sam: why inconsistent per-layer? probably the merger aligns small fragments differently; the int4 fused kernels assume 16-byte alignment and read nibble pairs with vector loads. An 8-byte shift would swap nibble pairing across words, producing tiny dequant errors that RoPE amplifies after wrap.

ci-bot: quick loader-strict check: LOADER_STRICT=1 failed on rt-int4 with assertion: layer 12 kv_buf.offset % 16 == 0 -> 8.

ravi: triage plan: (A) short-term loader fallback: if offset%16!=0 memcpy into an aligned mmap and proceed (fast path no-copy if aligned). (B) long-term: change serializer/merger to preserve tight packing and 16B alignment. (C) CI/regression: add longctx_compare 50k+ prefix test on any roundtripped int4 onboarding job.

sam: agree. loader-memcpy PoC good to have asap. Ravi, can you measure startup overhead?

ravi: PoC done: for 28GB artifact, memcpy alignment step adds ~1.2s on our build node. Nightly fuzz over 10 seeds looks healthy so far. I'll open PR for loader fallback + feature flag LOADER_ALLOW_UNALIGNED=true.

tay: I'll block onboarding of the offending artifact and add a test to onboarding CI that rejects artifacts that diverge vs fp16 on a 50k prefix (seeded).

perf-bot: scheduled: longctx_fuzz on rt-int4-fix branch, seeds=10, prefix=sample50k.txt, start=2026-03-20T23:00Z. Will post earliest divergence token per seed.

sam: note for release notes: "fix: enforce or correct 16B alignment for quantized checkpoint payloads to prevent RoPE drift on long contexts". Keep thread open until CI + perf green. :white_check_mark:
